distribution: Jinghong, Yunnan, 500 m above sea level.
soldier: Head yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal third deep yellow, labrum pale yellow, antennae milk-white with a pale yellow ring at the front of each segment, pronotum, abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head with several scattered long hairs; the front and the lateral margins of the labrum transparent, with a pair of apical hairs and three to four pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on each side; the margin of the pronotum with sparse long hairs. Head nearly square-rounded, widest in the middle; in profile raised like a hump in the middle of the head towards the front. Labrum tongue-shaped, its tip bluntly rounded. The front of the mandibles slender and curved inwards, each with a minute tooth-granule at the middle of its inner margin; the left basal tooth larger than the right, with a small tooth-granule within the concave edge of the basal tooth; a slightly larger denticle in front of the basal tooth of the right mandible. The widest part of the postmentum lies at the posterior third. Antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest. The middle of the pronotum depressed, the anterior and posterior parts slightly raised, the anterior and posterior margins concave in the middle. Small soldier: body and head colour as in the large soldier, except that the denticle within the concave edge of the basal tooth of the left mandible is slightly larger than that at the same site in the large soldier.
